quirks: The repository's own CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/gh-workflow, .github/CONTRIBUTING.md and pull request template still use closing keywords; this contract's 'Relates to #N' wins, because an issue is done only once its release is on Packagist.
The devcontainer's compose file publishes host port 8001 (MkDocs), so a second worktree stack cannot bind it while another stack runs.
The postCreateCommand (.devcontainer/setup.sh) runs 'pre-commit install', which needs a usable .git inside the container; a worktree's .git file points to the main checkout outside the mount.
The devcontainer runs PHP 8.5 while CI runs PHP 8.4 and composer.json pins platform PHP 8.4.
CI runs 'make test' with Xdebug coverage uploaded to Codecov; the local unit gate runs the no-coverage variant.
The required check 'Build image and run checks' builds the devcontainer and runs 'make install check test-examples' only when .devcontainer/ or its workflow changed, and passes as a no-op otherwise.
main accepts squash merges only and requires a code owner's approval and resolved review threads.
The repository has no 'ready' label yet.

stack.basis: Estimate: a single PHP devcontainer with no services; PHPStan runs with a 1 GiB memory limit; disk is the per-worktree vendor and caches, the base image is shared.
